title: Similar: Streaming TF-IDF Index Builder
goal: Refactor a TF-IDF corpus indexer so it can build exact search structures for a much larger document set under a strict RAM budget, while preserving the baseline ranking results.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source task’s text-indexing domain, but the decisive work is memory reduction: streaming token processing, avoiding full intermediate materialization, and using compact in-memory index representations.
